# infoblox_sharedrecordgroup (Resource)

Manages an Infoblox Sharedrecordgroup in the NIOS backend.

## Example Usage

### NIOS Backend

```terraform
// Create a Shared Record Group with Basic Fields
resource "infoblox_sharedrecordgroup" "shared_record_group_with_basic_fields" {
  nios = {
    name = "example-shared-record-group"
  }
}

// Create a Shared Record Group with Additional Fields
resource "infoblox_sharedrecordgroup" "shared_record_group_with_additional_fields" {
  nios = {
    name = "example-shared-record-group-2"

    // Additional Fields
    ext_attrs = {
      Site = "location-1"
    }
    record_name_policy = "Allow Any"
    comment            = "Shared Record Group created by Terraform"
  }
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `nios` (Attributes) NIOS backend-specific fields. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nios))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The reference to the object.

<a id="nestedatt--nios"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nios`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of this shared record group.

Optional:

- `comment` (String) The descriptive comment of this shared record group.
- `ext_attrs` (Map of String) Extensible attributes associated with the object. For valid values for extensible attributes, see {extattrs:values}.
- `record_name_policy` (String) The record name policy of this shared record group.
- `zone_associations` (Attributes List) The list of zones associated with this shared record group. Starting from NIOS-9.0.6, this field has been updated to a structure that includes FQDN and DNS view details. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nios--zone_associations))

Read-Only:

- `ext_attrs_all` (Map of String) All ext_attrs including Terraform Internal ID and inherited attributes.

<a id="nestedatt--nios--zone_associations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nios.zone_associations`

Optional:

- `fqdn` (String) The FQDN of the authoritative forward zone.
- `view` (String) The view to which the zone belongs. If a view is not specified, the default view is used.
